thread:
oncall-bot: Paging @alice (on-call): Dedicated pool 'resv-pool-4' GPU usage > 98% for 5m, queue depth rising, P95 latency > 12s. Auto-remediation attempted: scaleUp failed (quota). Incident severity: Sev2.

alice: acked. I'm looking. ETA 2m.

alice: quick snapshot: resv-pool-4 shows 48/48 reserved GPUs active. burst-enabled workloads are spilling into shared nodes; queue length spiking for enterprise tenants.

carol: seeing a ton of long-running jobs from tenant acme-corp and some unknown batch jobs in the same pool. KV cache pressure high.

ben: autoscaler logs show: 
```
ERROR: max_instances_reached: cannot provision, quota limit reached for project/redwood-eu
Traceback (most recent call last):
  ...
```
Looks like cloud quota prevented scale beyond 48.

maria-sre: I can join. Reassigning on-call lead to @maria-sre for next 30m to coordinate. @alice continue triage.

alice: thanks. Quick mitigations to consider: 1) throttle noisy tenant(s) 2) move high-priority enterprise tenants to fallback pool 3) kill or pause non-critical batch jobs 4) open quota request with cloud infra.

sam-cs: FYI @ton y-ce is on the account for Acme, they reported timeouts from their inference endpoints ~10:05 UTC. We've escalated to them. Please tell me what to say.

dave: priority: keep SLA-bound tenants running. If we must evict noisy workloads, prefer ephemeral/batch labels.

carol: command suggestions:
```
# list active jobs in pool
redwoodctl jobs list --pool resv-pool-4 --status running

# throttle tenant
redwoodctl tenant throttle set acme-corp --qps 10

# move tenant to fallback pool
redwoodctl tenant migrate acme-corp --from resv-pool-4 --to enterprise-fallback-eu-west --force
```

alice: executed `redwoodctl tenant throttle set acme-corp --qps 8` at 1842005702. Reduced incoming rate from ACME endpoints, will monitor.

ops-bot: Action audit: throttle applied by alice at 1842005702.

carol: started `redwoodctl tenant migrate` dry-run to ensure model compatibility on fallback pool. No model mismatches in manifest, should be safe.

ben: Cloud quota request opened: ticket #CLOUD-98765 (requested +12 GPUs in eu-west). ETA from cloud: 2-4 hours. Not fast enough.

maria-sre: attempting short-term capacity by draining low-priority nodes in pool and rebalancing. Planning to evict pods with label `workload=noncritical-batch`. 

alice: running eviction script now: `kubectl get pods -l pool=resv-pool-4,workload=noncritical-batch -o name | xargs -n1 kubectl delete --grace-period=30`

deploy-bot: Hotfix deploy in progress to autoscaler config: bump `scale_timeout` from 90s -> 30s to retry faster. Diff: https://git.internal/r/redwood/autoscaler/+/hotfix/scale-retry

ben: note: even if autoscaler retries, cloud quota will still block new instances. We need to free GPUs or migrate tenants.

ton y-ce: Acme confirmed perf degradation, want status. @sam-cs, please let them know we're throttling to reduce tail latency and migrating them to fallback pool.

sam-cs: message to customer: "We're actively mitigating. We've applied a temporary rate limit to reduce errors and are migrating your workloads to a fallback pool; you'll see reduced latency as we complete the move. We'll follow up when migration completes or if any action is required on your side." Sending now.

alice: migration started for acme-corp at 1842005920. Travelcheck shows 3/12 models already warmed on enterprise-fallback-eu-west.

carol: noticed noisy jobs from tenant 'research-team-x' without reservation. They are hitting GPU 7 heavily with long sequences. Proposing we pause them for 10 minutes.

maria-sre: pausing research-team-x batch jobs now. `redwoodctl job pause --tenant research-team-x --reason "incident mitigation"`

ops-bot: Action audit: paused 6 jobs for research-team-x by maria-sre at 1842006105.

alice: after throttles + pauses + initial migration, queue depth dropped 45% and P95 down to 6.2s. Still above SLO but trending down.

ben: cloud quota still pending; I can open an expedited request. If engineering approves, we can send CS-led request to expedite.

maria-sre: agree. Escalate to infra ops: `@infra-oncall` (ben) please escalate for urgent quota bump. Also capturing timeline for postmortem: autoscaler hit max, noisy neighbor + burst jobs in reserved pool, fallback capacity usage not automatic.

dave: DM me any customer-facing status updates. We should prepare a mitigation note for enterprise clients.

alice: migration completed for acme-corp at 1842006450. Verified 12/12 model instances warmed. Observed error rate for acme endpoints down from 6% -> 0.9%.

sam-cs: customer notified: Acme acknowledged the update, appreciative of the quick migration, asked for root cause and SLA credit if applicable.

carol: follow-up checks: KV cache hit rate dropped briefly during migration, warmed back up in ~4m. No data loss.

maria-sre: preparing mitigation checklist and next steps:
- keep throttles for 1h, then roll back if stable
- keep research-team-x paused until end of their window (T+2h)
- pursue quota bump with cloud, expedite if possible
- update autoscaler heuristics to prefer moving reserved tenants to fallback pools earlier
- postmortem w/in 72h

alice: handing off to maria-sre for remainder of incident window. I'll be available if needed.

maria-sre: taking lead. Creating incident channel and incident doc. Noting timeline and actions. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Incident update: Sev2 -> mitigated (customer impact reduced). Retain watch for 1h.

maria-sre: action items assigned: ben -> expedite quota, carol -> postmortem draft, sam-cs -> customer follow-up and possible SLA credit comms, dave -> enterprise comms draft.

alice: thanks everyone. Closing slack thread for active triage, will reopen if we detect regression.

oncall-bot: Thread locked to incident channel watchers.
